arguments.installCommand: printf '%s\n' 'IDE component installation is managed in Packages > IDE Kit Library. Review the component plan there.' >&2; exit 78
arguments.name: Java · Eclipse JDT LS 1.63.0
arguments.runCommand: set -eu; . /opt/sui-code/java.env; test -x "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" || { echo "[E_JDK] Selected JDK is unavailable" >&2; exit 78; }; ROOT=/opt/sui-code/ide/java/current; CONFIG="$HOME/.sui-code/jdtls/${workspaceId}/config-1.63.0-$(uname -m)"; mkdir -p "$(dirname "$CONFIG")"; if [ ! -d "$CONFIG" ]; then case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64) BASE=config_linux_arm ;; *) BASE=config_linux ;; esac; cp -R "$ROOT/$BASE" "$CONFIG"; fi; exec "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" -Xmx768m -Declipse.application=org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core.id1 -Declipse.product=org.eclipse.jdt.ls.core.product -Dosgi.bundles.defaultStartLevel=4 --add-modules=ALL-SYSTEM --add-opens java.base/java.util=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED -jar $(find "$ROOT/plugins" -maxdepth 1 -name 'org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar' -print -quit) -configuration "$CONFIG" -data "$HOME/.sui-code/jdtls/${workspaceId}/data"
arguments.verifyCommand: test -r /opt/sui-code/java.env && . /opt/sui-code/java.env && test -x "$JAVA_HOME/bin/java" && ( case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64) base=config_linux_arm;; *) base=config_linux;; esac; test -r "/opt/sui-code/ide/java/current/$base/config.ini" ) && test -n "$(find /opt/sui-code/ide/java/current/plugins -name 'org.eclipse.equinox.launcher_*.jar' -print -quit)"
